class.name: BehaviorState

method.name: _enter
method.description: Called when the machine switches to this state.

method.name: _exit
method.description: Called when the machine switches away from this state, or stops.

method.name: _setup
method.description: Called once, when the outermost machine starts, before any state is entered.

method.name: _update
method.description: Called every tick while this is the active state, with the time since the last tick.

method.name: get_machine
method.description: The machine this state belongs to.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Whether this is its machine's active state.

method.name: send_event
method.description: Sends [param event] to this state's machine, which switches state if it has a transition for it (see [method BehaviorStateMachine.add_transition]). If it doesn't, the machine round it gets the chance, and so on outwards.

method.name: transition_to
method.description: Switches the machine to [param state]: another state's name, or a path to it from the machine.

members.member: The node the states control: the outermost machine's parent.
The values every state shares, which the game can read and write too. Set on the outermost machine; every state inside it uses that one.

signal.name: entered
signal.description: Emitted when the machine switches to this state.

signal.name: exited
signal.description: Emitted when the machine switches away from this state.
